about: The free unit practice tests (unit-tests/<unit>.html) chosen by hand for the BC units, 12 bank questions each: every topic or nearly, single-answer and numeric items only, no lesson check and no practice-exam question, a set's items together in authored order (docs/apcalcbc-spec.md row 3; checked by checkUnitTests in scripts/lib/apcalcbc-exams.mjs). A unit not listed gets the automatic sample (unitSample in scripts/lib/apcalc-entry.mjs).
